description: This line plot illustrates how the PPL (Perplexity) metric varies with increasing evaluation context length for three different values of the frequency domain compression parameter γ (γ=0.25, γ=0.5, γ=0.75). The x-axis, labeled "Evaluation Context Length", is plotted on a linear scale ranging from 2K to 64K, with tick marks at intervals of 2K. The y-axis, labeled "PPL", is also on a linear scale, ranging from approximately 7.7 to 8.1. The plot displays three distinct lines: the blue line with circle markers for γ=0.25, the orange line with circle markers for γ=0.5, and the green line with circle markers for γ=0.75. All three lines start at a PPL value of approximately 8.1 at 2K context length. The blue line (γ=0.25) shows a steep initial decline to about 7.82 at 4K, then plateaus slightly before declining again to about 7.78 at 64K. The orange line (γ=0.5) follows a similar trend, starting at 8.1, dropping to about 7.74 at 8K, and then remaining relatively flat at approximately 7.74 from 16K to 64K. The green line (γ=0.75) also begins at 8.1, decreases to about 7.74 at 8K, and then remains nearly flat at approximately 7.72 from 16K to 64K.
